risks.risk: Original vs reprint/photocopy cannot be confirmed from cover-only photos; counterfeit/reprints often look similar on the outside.
risks.proof: Ask for clear photos of the copyright page and ISBN barcode for at least 2–3 different titles (including one of the most expensive-looking covers).
risks.if_unproven: Price as reprint/unknown authenticity (worst case for value).

risks.risk: Seller’s “no writing inside” claim cannot be verified without seeing inside pages; could have notes, stamps, or underlining.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video/clip flipping through 5–10 pages in 2 books, showing blank/first pages and any markings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possibly written-in (worst case for resale).

risks.risk: Condition issues (missing pages, torn covers, water damage) are not shown.
risks.proof: Ask for close-ups of corners/spine and a photo of the bottom edge of pages for 2 books.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming average wear (worst case among plausible conditions).

risks.risk: Exact count and which titles are included in the 5-copy vs 10-copy bundles is unclear.
risks.proof: Ask for a list of the exact titles included in the 5-copy bundle and the 10-copy bundle (or a photo showing all copies laid out).
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming the bundle may include lower-demand titles (worst case match).

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the copyright page + ISBN barcode for at least 2–3 titles (not just covers).
Send a short video flipping through inside pages of 2 books to confirm there is no writing/notes/stamps.
Send close-ups of spine, corners, and page edges for 2 books to confirm condition.
Confirm the exact titles included in the 5-copy bundle and the 10-copy bundle (list or photo showing all books laid out).
response.reason: The photos confirm assorted book titles on the covers, but they do not verify the seller’s key value claims (original vs reprint, and no writing inside). Without proof, the worst-case value could be much lower.
